clocks.msi.note: Reset default (2MHz) works; MSIRANGE change hangs — needs L0 errata study

timer.wdog.note: Starved-refresh reset verified earlier, but the timeout assumed a 32 kHz LSI; the L0's is 37 kHz nominal (26-56 kHz, DS table 39), so the 5 s watchdog fired at ~4.3 s. Prescaler scaled per family (LL_LSI_HZ), fixed 2026-09-25 (RM0377), awaiting bench. Not calibrated against HSI16, so the timeout still varies part to part.

adc.mv.note: VREFINT was never enabled on the L0 before 2026-09-22 (VREFEN written to reserved CFGR2 bits), so earlier readings were ~9x off. Fixed; VDDA now reads 3292 mV on a ~3.3 V rail. Re-verify with known input voltages.

adc.temp.note: Reads sensor; factory cal at 0x1FF8007A — value offset needs investigation

adc.dma_mv.note: Scan-to-millivolt chain verified on silicon 2026-09-22; absolute accuracy not yet checked against known input voltages.

power.stop.note: The hang was not the wakeup path: the LSI helpers set LSEON (RCC_CSR bit 8) and waited forever on LSERDY; LSE/LSI bits were swapped. Fixed 2026-09-25 (register map per RM0377 §7.3.20; WUF cleared before each Stop per Table 39; RTC wake vector enabled under PRIMASK; sleeps in fed chunks while the watchdog runs, which the L0 cannot freeze in Stop), awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle)

power.standby.note: Same LSI fix as power.stop, plus WUTF cleared before entry (RM0377 Table 40). Refuses (HAL_ERROR) a Standby longer than half the watchdog timeout, since the L0 IWDG keeps running in Standby. Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_wake.note: RTC wakeup timer on LSI (37 kHz nominal), EXTI line 20 + NVIC vector 2. Fixed 2026-09-25 (RM0377), awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle)

power.exti_wake.note: core_stop_until_on_change now waits for the pad edge itself and wakes to feed a running watchdog. Reworked 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_alarm.note: Alarm A (ALRMAR 0x1C, ALRAWF) was unreachable while the RTC clock init hung on the LSE. Fixed 2026-09-25 (register map per RM0377 §7.3.20 / §22.7), awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle T2)

power.backup.note: 5 backup registers (RTC_BKP0R-4R at RTC+0x50, RM0377 §22.7.20); the RTC-clock bring-up they need hung on the LSE. Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle T1)

adv.comp.note: L011 has COMP1/COMP2 but not routed on Core.ST.L0.1 pinout
